text:
rachel: Hey folks — Brightway on a POC just pinged: their UI export says 42k tokens for the day but the billing page shows 33,450 tokens and their free trial credits didn't reduce the CSV. Customer is asking why. Org: brightway-llc, account contact: Mark.
devon: Can you paste the org ID and the CSV snippet? Also did they run embeddings + chat in same pipeline? Those are billed differently.
mark_brightway: org id org_bright_109. CSV row from dashboard: `2026-03-22,requests=412,total_tokens=42187,csv_tokens=42187`. Billing page shows charged_tokens=33450, credits_applied=8750. We expected CSV to show net tokens after credits.
arun: Quick checklist: 1) free credits should show in billing summary as credits_applied (not in raw CSV export). 2) CSV historically showed raw token counts; we made a recent change to add a "net_tokens" column but it didn't roll out to all UI builds. Could be a mismatch between CDN cached frontend and backend.
devon: Did they have any rapid retry pattern? retries can inflate raw counts if client didn't dedupe.
mark_brightway: We did get a few 429s yesterday from a background job. The client retried automatically. We assumed idempotency prevented charges for retries.
arun: Important: retries that reach our ingestion endpoints are billable. We can audit request-ids. If they used idempotency keys we can merge, otherwise billed.
ops-bot: (automated) Billing snapshot for org_bright_109: month_estimate=$1,120, credits_remaining=$8,750, alerts=[email_me_at: mark@brightway.com], webhooks_enabled=false.
devon: Can you export the internal usage lines for the day? A sample would help compare CSV vs invoice.
mark_brightway: here's their exported sample JSON from dashboard (copied): `{"date":"2026-03-22","requests":412,"total_tokens":42187,"free_credits_shown":8750}`
arun: Thanks. I'm seeing two contributors: (A) ~6.8k extra tokens from retries between 14:20-14:35 UTC, and (B) a UI export bug: our frontend was displaying "total_tokens" but an older backend job populated a stale column which doubled streaming chunk tallies for certain models. That makes exported CSV appear higher than billed.
rachel: So invoice is correct and CSV is inflated? We need to explain to the customer and provide corrected CSV.
arun: Correct. Invoice uses final_token_count. CSV bug (ENG-7905) is to switch exports to final_token_count and show a net_tokens column with credits applied. I'm opening the patch now and will request a backfill for the CSV exports for affected orgs.
devon: Also to confirm retries: about 120 repeated requests were billed (non-idempotent), totaling ~6.8k tokens. We'll mark which request-ids were charged and which were only CSV artifacts.
mark_brightway: If retries were billed due to our client, can we get a one-time courtesy credit? This is a POC and the pattern was due to a third-party SDK.
rachel: I'll escalate. Sales policy allows small one-time credits for POCs under $500 — will confirm with billing ops.
ops-bot: (automated) Support ticket created: S-90012 assigned to billing-ops; priority medium.
arun: Tech note for engineers: recommend customers use idempotency keys for message-level calls and server-side dedupe on background jobs. Also streaming chunks should not be summed for billing; we'll remove raw_stream_chunk aggregation.
devon: Action list: 1) Arun to produce corrected CSV + list of charged request-ids (ETA 3h). 2) Rachel to request courtesy credit and notify Mark (ETA 4h). 3) Ops to enable webhook alerts for org_bright_109 temporarily (ETA 1h). 4) Billing ops to review S-90012 and confirm if refund/credit approved.
mark_brightway: Appreciate the fast response. Also can you enable a webhook or Slack alert when their month_estimate crosses 75% of threshold? We missed email.
rachel: Noted — we'll set up a webhook and a Slack forward for now. Longer term we'll add webhook config to the console (feature ticket SALES-412).
arun: I'll add a brief public-facing note in the docs clarifying how free credits appear vs raw CSV exports so other customers aren't confused. ENG ticket ENG-7905 will include release notes.
mark_brightway: Thanks all. Please send corrected CSV and confirm credits decision.
devon: Will do. Updating thread with files and ticket links when ready. :white_check_mark:
